positions.name: DeploymentGateAsRatifiedRule
positions.frame: how does a deployment gate get performed as a settled operational rule — with its scope and owner assigned — rather than as a proposal still under argument?
positions.why: All four expressions perform the same directional read: a mandatory signed-manifest gate is stated as a ratified decision, not a position being argued. src-1 declares the requirement and justifies it with a past incident; src-3 records the gate itself; src-4 fixes its scope across staging and production; src-5 names the accountable owner. Together they constitute a complete operational rule — mandate, justification, scope, ownership — each member performing a settled, unhedged declarative. The conviction gradient is flat across all four: no hedging, no alternatives voiced, no proposal language.
